content:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few pricing/credits questions bubbled up that we should capture here. Can leadership confirm "credits vs quota" shorthand so we can update the handbook?
devin: Short version: credits = prepaid consumption currency on Hosted; quotas = enforced limits (tokens/requests) applied by org/route/pool. Dedicated customers get reserved throughput (not credits).
sam: Do unused hosted credits roll over to next billing period? Also can credits be auto-applied to Dedicated overage?
devin: No, self-serve hosted credits are non-rollover. For Dedicated, overages are billed separately per contract; some enterprise deals allow credit offsets — handled case-by-case by finance.
lina: What about burst behavior: can Hosted burst above quota during regional slack? Example: production landing page sees a sudden spike.
devin: We support controlled bursting for Hosted but within a safety envelope: max short-burst tokens and burst requests/min are governed by org tier and current cluster headroom. If headroom is low we fallback to compatible smaller models or throttle. For Dedicated, customers configure burst window in the pool policy.
maria: Is there an API customers can call to show remaining credits/quotas in their app?
sam: We saw an internal endpoint today — public GET /v1/orgs/{org}/usage planned. It will return remaining credits, daily/weekly token windows, and per-route thresholds. Docs PR pending.
ops-bot: alert: billing dashboard patch deployed to staging. Will roll to prod after QA.
billing-bot: note: invoice rules reminder: prepaid credits are applied before usage billing; refunds are only per contract.
maria: Can we get a one-page summary for Support + Sales that includes trial defaults, rollover policy, and burst rules?
devin: I'll spin up the one-pager and a short FAQ draft. Sam, Lina — can you both sanity-check the numbers for trial limits?
sam: Yep, will check and send numbers this afternoon.
lina: I can add the burst examples and fallback mappings.
maria: Thanks all :pray:
